rationale: Record where ReadIndex confirmation support is filtered by current membership. The earlier refutation of the removed-voter quorum question rested partly on a measured dropped response; this trace locates the two source filters that produce it and checks the witness variant of the same suspicion. A hint-carrying heartbeat is sent only to current voting members, so an observer or witness never receives a nonzero context to echo while a read is pending, and a HeartbeatResp is admitted through lw, which resolves the sender against the current remotes, observers and witnesses maps and drops it when it is in none of them. readIndex.confirm counts the admitted sender without a further role check, so the protection is the send-side voter filter plus the admission-time role lookup rather than a role check in the quorum count. A witness cannot occupy a voter acknowledgement seat through this path: it is never sent the hint, and a node that left the voter set is dropped at admission.

knowledge.statement: When a ReadIndex request is pending, broadcastHeartbeatMessage uses readIndex.peepCtx as the heartbeat context and broadcastHeartbeatMessageWithHint sends that hint-carrying heartbeat only to current voting members; observers receive a heartbeat only when the context is zero, and witnesses are not addressed. On the leader, a HeartbeatResp is admitted through lw, which resolves the sender against the current remotes, observers and witnesses maps and drops the message when it is in none of them, after which handleLeaderHeartbeatResp passes a nonzero hint to handleReadIndexLeaderConfirmation and readIndex.confirm counts the admitted sender without a further role check.
knowledge.conditions: The node is leader with at least one pending ReadIndex request, the role maps reflect the current configuration, and a heartbeat response arrives from a node that is currently a voter, an observer, a witness, or in no role map.
